anti_patterns: using cards for every type of content
multiple animation engines for the same effect

highlight_amber.text_rule: prefer dark text on amber backgrounds

text_secondary.note: verify WCAG contrast for actual font size/background

usage: hover and pressed states for teal actions

approximate_color_distribution.note: composition guidance only, not a rigid rule

animation.rule: Use for small meaningful UI transitions only when CSS is insufficient.

component_source.rule: Optional; select and adapt individual components, never copy a whole demo page.

icons.rule: Optional consistent icon family; no decorative icon clutter.

charts.rule: Candidate for monitoring charts only when required by actual data and after inspecting existing dependencies.

optional_with_justification.GSAP: Complex timeline or scroll sequence only; do not animate the same component with Motion too.
optional_with_justification.Lenis: Optional public editorial landing page only; not for dashboard/admin flows by default.
optional_with_justification.Aceternity UI or Magic UI: Alternative source for a specific component; do not combine as multiple visual systems.
optional_with_justification.Three.js / React Three Fiber / Drei: Not in MVP by default; only for an approved functional 3D requirement.

libraries.install_rule: Inspect package.json and existing code first; add only dependencies required for the current task.

motion.default: subtle opacity and transform transitions for meaningful state changes
avoid: animating large data tables on every render

content_rules.provenance: show source and update period when known
content_rules.demo_data: must be clearly labeled and must not become production defaults

frontend_architecture.rule: Create modules incrementally; keep backend business logic in FastAPI.
